name: Ukukhathazeka
sources: National Department of Health Mental Health Directorate

what_is_it.heading: Ukukhathazeka ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Ukukhathazeka yilokho okuzwayo lapho isistimu ye-alamu yomzimba wakho idubula kaningi, kakhulu, noma ingekho ingozi yangempela ekhona. Wonke umuntu uzizwa ekhathazekile ngezinye izikhathi. Isifo sokukhathazeka yilapho singena endleleni yokuphila evamile.
paragraphs: Kunezinhlobo eziningi: ukukhathazeka okuvamile (ukukhathazeka njalo), ukwesaba (amagagasi angazelelwe okwesaba okukhulu), ukukhathazeka komphakathi (ukwesaba ukwahlulelwa), ama-phobias athile, i-PTSD ngemva kokuhlukumezeka. Ziyagqagqana futhi zabelana ngezimiso zokwelashwa.

Ukukhathazeka kunengxenye eqinile yomzimba - inhliziyo egijima, ukujuluka, ukuphefumula, isiyezi, isicanucanu, ukuthuthumela. Umzimba uzwa sengathi usengozini ngisho noma ingqondo yazi ukuthi ayikho. Lokhu kuyiqiniso, hhayi 'konke okusekhanda lakho'. Iyelapheka.

items.headline: Okuvame kakhulu
items.body: Izinkinga zokukhathazeka yiqembu elivame kakhulu lezimo zempilo yengqondo emhlabeni. Cishe umuntu oyedwa kwabahlanu waseNingizimu Afrika uba nesikhathi esisodwa.

items.headline: Kuyalapheka
items.body: I-Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), imithi, kanye nezinguquko zendlela yokuphila kusebenza kahle kakhulu kubantu abaningi. Akumele uphile nayo.

items.headline: Okomzimba futhi
items.body: Ukukhathazeka kuzwakala emzimbeni - ukugijima kwenhliziyo, ukuphefumula, isiyezi. Abantu bavame ukucabanga ukuthi banesifo senhliziyo. Ukuyiqaphela ukuthi iyini kuyasiza.

items.headline: Usizo lwamahhala
items.body: I-SADAG ne-LifeLine zinikeza ukwelulekwa kwamahhala kokukhathazeka. Imitholampilo ihlinzeka ngokuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwamahhala. Usizo luseduze kunalokho ucabanga.

pull_quote.text: Ukukhathazeka akulona uphawu lobuthakathaka. Kuwuphawu lokuthi isistimu yakho ye-alamu isebenza isikhathi esengeziwe. Izindaba ezinhle: amasistimu ama-alamu angaqeqeshwa kabusha.

signs.heading: Yeka ukuthi ukukhathazeka kubukeka kanjani
signs.lede: Ukukhathazeka kubonakala ngezindlela ezintathu eziyinhloko—emzimbeni, engqondweni, nasekuziphatheni. Cishe uyaziqaphela ezinye zazo.

items.title: Emzimbeni
items.description: Inhliziyo egijimayo, ukuphefumula okusheshayo noma ukuzwa ungakwazi ukubamba umoya wakho, ukujuluka, ukuthuthumela, isicanucanu noma ukuphatheka kabi kwesisu, isiyezi, isifuba esiqinile, ukuntweza, ukushisa noma ukushisa okubandayo.

items.title: Emqondweni
items.description: Ukukhathazeka njalo — ngisho nangezinto ezincane, umuzwa wokwethuka, ukugijima kwengqondo, ukulindela okubi kakhulu, awukwazi ukugxilisa ingqondo, imicabango ethi 'kungenzeka yini', ubunzima bokulala.

items.title: Ekuziphatheni
items.description: Ukugwema izimo ezikwenza ukhathazeke, udinga ukuqinisekiswa njalo, uhlolwe futhi uhlolwe kabusha, ukucasuka, ukuhoxa kubantu, ukusebenzisa utshwala noma izinto ukuze wehlise umoya.

items.myth: Ukukhathazeka nje ukukhathazeka kakhulu. Yeka ukucabanga ngokweqile.
items.fact: Izinkinga zokukhathazeka zihlanganisa izinguquko zangempela ebuchosheni nasemzimbeni - hhayi nje amaphethini okucabanga. Ukutshela umuntu ukuthi 'vele uyeke ukukhathazeka' kufana nokutshela onesifo sikashukela ukuthi 'vele ulawule ushukela wakho'. Akusebenzi.

items.myth: Imithi yokukhathazeka iyalutha futhi ikwenza ube zombie.
items.fact: Imithi yesimanje yokulwa nokukhathazeka (i-SSRIs ikakhulukazi) ayilutheki. Ithulisa isistimu ye-alamu ngokwanele ukuthi amakhono okwelapha nawokubhekana nawo angasebenza. Akushintshi ukuthi ungubani.
Ukukhathazeka yisimo sezempilo esinezinguquko ezilinganisekayo kumakhemikhali obuchopho, izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo, namazinga amahomoni. Ukuthi abanye abayiboni akusho ukuthi akwenzeki.

items.myth: Uma usunokukhathazeka, uba nakho ukuphila kwakho konke.
items.fact: Abantu abaningi abathola ukwelashwa okufanele ngenxa yokukhathazeka babona ukuthuthuka okukhulu futhi abaningi balulama ngokugcwele. Ngisho nokukhathazeka okukhulu kusabela ekwelapheni nasekwelashweni lapho kunikezwa ithuba.

items.title: Funda ukusetha kabusha ukuphefumula
items.description: Lapho ukukhathazeka kukhula: phefumula ngokubala okungu-4, ubambe ku-4, uphume ka-6. Ukuphefumula okude kuthulisa isimiso sezinzwa. Yisebenzise ngesikhathi sokwethuka — isebenza phakathi nomzuzu.

items.title: Yisho uma uyizwa
items.description: Ukuthi 'lokhu ukukhathazeka, hhayi isifo senhliziyo' kusiza ukuhlukanisa i-alamu yomzimba engozini yangempela. Yehlisa ukwethuka-mayelana-nokwethuka.

items.title: Sika i-caffeine uma ungakwazi
items.description: I-caffeine ilingisa ngokuqondile izimpawu zokukhathazeka - inhliziyo egijima, ukujabula. Abantu abaningi babona ukuthuthuka okukhulu emavikini angu-2-3 okunciphisa noma ukuyeka.

items.title: Hamba uye emtholampilo uyohlolwa
items.description: Imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngokuhlolwa kwamahhala kwempilo yengqondo. Khuluma nomhlengikazi wezempilo yengqondo. Usizo olusekelwe ku-CBT nemithi uma kudingeka imahhala.

items.title: Uma kuwukuhlasela kwe-panic ikakhulukazi
items.description: Funda mayelana nokulawulwa kokuhlaselwa ukwethuka - ukwazi iphethini (ukuphakama emizuzwini eyi-10, akukaze kube yingozi, kudlula njalo) kuthatha ukwesaba okukhulu kubo.

get_help.heading: Ubani okufanele ashayele
get_help.lede: Ukukhathazeka kusabela kahle kakhulu ekwelashweni. Ingxenye enzima kakhulu ukufinyelela okokuqala. I-SADAG ne-LifeLine yenza lokho kube lula - mahhala, kuyimfihlo, akukho ukwahlulela.

helplines.description: Ukwelulekwa kwamahhala, okuyimfihlo kokukhathazeka, ukwethuka, kanye nengcindezi
